subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs become actively resolved credentials before or alongside the optional-TTS SecretRef startup-degradation work?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but broadening credential collection can change failure behavior for existing persona TTS configs, and automation should not decide that merge-order risk alone.

options.title: Require Proof And Credential Review
options.body: Ask for a redacted live TTS or Gateway run showing a file-source persona SecretRef resolving, then land after owner review accepts the active credential-routing behavior.

options.title: Coordinate With Optional TTS Startup Work
options.body: Wait for or merge alongside https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 if maintainers do not want newly collected missing persona TTS refs to stay startup-fatal under current policy.

options.title: Accept Targeted Tests Only
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge on collector, registry, command-target, and CI evidence alone, but that accepts unproven external runtime behavior for a credential path.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Credential Review
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted live TTS or Gateway run showing a file-source persona SecretRef resolving, then land after owner review accepts the active credential-routing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the SecretRef collector, registry, and runtime assignment semantics introduced in the broad SecretRef coverage work.
